dataplex_zone.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only references an existing Dataplex zone and does not control security or access.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: This does have a security_impact as it protects critical assets from accidental deletion through Terraform.

description.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it is descriptive metadata used for documentation only.

display_name.rationale: This does not have a security impact as it is a user-friendly identifier and does not affect security or permissions.

labels.description:
Optional. User defined labels for the asset.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as labels are descriptive metadata used for organization, cost allocation, and management rather than enforcing security.

lake.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only references the Dataplex lake that contains the asset.

location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

name.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it is only used to uniquely identify the asset.

project.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only identifies the GCP project in which the resource is created and does not enforce security controls.

discovery_spec.description: Required. Specification of the discovery feature applied to data referenced by this asset. When this spec is left unset, the asset will use the spec set on the parent zone.

discovery_spec.enabled.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it controls whether metadata discovery is enabled, which is an operational data management feature rather than a security control.

discovery_spec.exclude_patterns.description: Optional. The list of patterns to apply for selecting data to exclude during discovery. For Cloud Storage bucket assets, these are interpreted as glob patterns used to match object names. For BigQuery dataset assets, these are interpreted as patterns to match table names.
discovery_spec.exclude_patterns.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only controls which data is excluded from discovery and does not affect access control or resource security.

discovery_spec.include_patterns.description: Optional. The list of patterns to apply for selecting data to include during discovery if only a subset of the data should considered. For Cloud Storage bucket assets, these are interpreted as glob patterns used to match object names. For BigQuery dataset assets, these are interpreted as patterns to match table names.
discovery_spec.include_patterns.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only controls which data is included in discovery and does not grant or restrict permissions.

discovery_spec.schedule.description: Optional. Cron schedule (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cron) for running discovery periodically. Successive discovery runs must be scheduled at least 60 minutes apart. The default value is to run discovery every 60 minutes. To explicitly set a timezone to the cron tab, apply a prefix in the cron tab: "CRON_TZ=${IANA_TIME_ZONE}" or TZ=${IANA_TIME_ZONE}". The ${IANA_TIME_ZONE} may only be a valid string from IANA time zone database. For example, "CRON_TZ=America/New_York 1 * * * *", or "TZ=America/New_York 1 * * * *".
discovery_spec.schedule.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only specifies how often discovery runs and does not affect the security of the resource.

discovery_spec.csv_options.delimiter.description: Optional. The delimiter being used to separate values. This defaults to ','.
discovery_spec.csv_options.delimiter.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only specifies how CSV data is parsed.

discovery_spec.csv_options.disable_type_.description: Optional. Whether to disable the inference of data type for CSV data. If true, all columns will be registered as strings.
discovery_spec.csv_options.disable_type_.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only controls how CSV data types are inferred during discovery.

discovery_spec.csv_options.encoding.description: Optional. The character encoding of the data. The default is UTF-8.
discovery_spec.csv_options.encoding.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only specifies the character encoding used to read CSV files.

discovery_spec.csv_options.header_rows.description: Optional. The number of rows to interpret as header rows that should be skipped when reading data rows.
discovery_spec.csv_options.header_rows.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only specifies the number of header rows in CSV files.

discovery_spec.json_options.disable_type.description: Optional. Whether to disable the inference of data type for Json data. If true, all columns will be registered as their primitive types (strings, number or boolean).
discovery_spec.json_options.disable_type.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only controls how JSON data types are inferred during discovery.

discovery_spec.json_options.encoding.description: Optional. The character encoding of the data. The default is UTF-8.
discovery_spec.json_options.encoding.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only specifies the character encoding used to read JSON files.

resource_spec.description: Required. Immutable. Specification of the resource that is referenced by this asset.

resource_spec.name.description: Immutable. Relative name of the cloud resource that contains the data that is being managed within a lake. For example: `projects/{project_number}/buckets/{bucket_id}` `projects/{project_number}/datasets/{dataset_id}`
resource_spec.name.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only identifies the referenced storage bucket or BigQuery dataset.

resource_spec.read_access_mode.description: Optional. Determines how read permissions are handled for each asset and their associated tables. Only available to storage buckets assets. Possible values: DIRECT, MANAGED
resource_spec.read_access_mode.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it determines how Dataplex manages access to the underlying resource but does not itself enforce or strengthen security.

resource_spec.type.description: Required. Immutable. Type of resource. Possible values: STORAGE_BUCKET, BIGQUERY_DATASET
resource_spec.type.rationale: This does not have a security_impact as it only specifies the type of resource being referenced and does not control security settings.
